claims.text: Discord says in its own job posting that it is opening an engineering hub in Lisbon, its first dedicated one outside its San Francisco headquarters.
claims.quote: Discord is opening an engineering hub in Lisbon, our first dedicated one outside of our San Francisco HQ.

claims.text: Observador reports, from a Discord posting, that the Lisbon office will not be a satellite office but a place with real technical autonomy (Portuguese original quoted).
claims.quote: não será um escritório satélite, mas sim um local com verdadeira autonomia técnica

claims.text: Observador reports that candidates are asked to be in the office three to four times a week.
claims.quote: ir ao escritório três a quatro vezes por semana

claims.text: Observador reports that Discord left the details of the Lisbon office to a press conference the following Wednesday.
claims.quote: A Discord remeteu detalhes sobre este escritório em Lisboa para uma conferência na próxima quarta-feira.

claims.text: Tek Notícias reports that the hub is meant to employ about 30 workers by the end of 2027, as the company confirms.
claims.quote: O objetivo é que o hub possa empregar cerca de 30 trabalhadores até final de 2027, confirma a empresa.

claims.text: Tek Notícias reports that Discord already has a European headquarters in Amsterdam and that this is its first engineering hub outside the United States.
claims.quote: A empresa já tem uma sede europeia em Amesterdão.

claims.text: Tek Notícias reports that the announcement was planned for a press conference at Web Summit and the closure for bad weather changed the plans.
claims.quote: O anúncio estava previsto para uma conferência de imprensa no Web Summit mas o encerramento devido ao mau tempo acabou por mudar os planos

claims.text: Tek Notícias quotes Discord's CTO and co-founder Stanislav Vishnevskiy (in Portuguese): Lisbon has established itself as one of Europe's main centres of talent and innovation.
claims.quote: Lisboa consolidou-se como um dos principais centros de talento e inovação da Europa

claims.text: Diário de Notícias reports that the Lisbon centre will have direct responsibility for the platform's core tech: network reliability, low-latency audio and video, data management, and moderation and safety tools.
claims.quote: o polo de Lisboa terá responsabilidades diretas sobre a chamada " core tech " da plataforma

claims.text: Diário de Notícias reports that Discord plans to hire about 30 engineers by 2027 for audio, video and data infrastructure from Lisbon.
claims.quote: planeia contratar cerca de 30 engenheiros até 2027
